title: Reception of the SecurityModeCommand by the UE

entities.name: Security Mode Control Procedure
entities.description: Procedure where UE receives SecurityModeCommand message and activates AS security upon successful integrity verification.

entities.name: SecurityModeCommand
entities.description: RRC message that initiates security activation, containing integrity and ciphering algorithms.

entities.name: SecurityModeComplete
entities.description: RRC message sent by UE after successful security activation, transmitted unciphered.

entities.name: SecurityModeFailure
entities.description: RRC message sent by UE if integrity protection check fails.

entities.name: integrityProtAlgorithm
entities.description: Indicates the integrity protection algorithm to be used for SRB protection.

entities.name: cipheringAlgorithm
entities.description: Indicates the ciphering algorithm to be used for SRB protection.

entities.name: K_RRCint
entities.description: Integrity protection key for RRC signaling derived from K_gNB and integrityProtAlgorithm.

entities.name: K_RRCenc
entities.description: Ciphering key for RRC signaling derived from K_gNB and cipheringAlgorithm.

entities.name: K_UPint
entities.description: Integrity protection key for user plane derived from K_gNB and integrityProtAlgorithm.

entities.name: K_UPenc
entities.description: Ciphering key for user plane derived from K_gNB and cipheringAlgorithm.

entities.name: Integrity protection check passes
entities.description: Condition where SecurityModeCommand message passes integrity verification.

entities.name: AS security activated
entities.description: State where UE considers AS security to be activated after successful security mode procedure.

relations.description: Procedure execution is guarded by integrity check condition.
Successful integrity check establishes AS security activation.
Successful integrity check leads to transmission of SecurityModeComplete.
Failed integrity check leads to transmission of SecurityModeFailure.
SecurityModeCommand message requires integrity protection verification.
